description: Test suite for channel configuration helpers and adapters in a plugin SDK for a chat/channel application. Contains unit tests verifying behavior of functions related to scoped and top-level channel configurations, account accessors, allowFrom/defaultTo resolution, and security policies.

methods.name: resolveDefaultAccountId
methods.description: Returns the default account ID from imported constant.

methods.name: function createConfigWritesCfg() { createConfigWritesCfg
methods.description: Creates a mock configuration object for testing, specifying channel configs and account permissions.

methods.name: function expectAdapterAllowFromAndDefaultTo(adapter: unknown) { expectAdapterAllowFromAndDefaultTo
methods.description: Helper to test resolveAllowFrom and resolveDefaultTo functions of adapters.

methods.name: mapAllowFromEntries
methods.description: Converts allowFrom entries to string list, coercing types.

methods.name: resolveOptionalConfigString
methods.description: Trims and coerces input into a string or undefined.

methods.name: resolveChannelConfigWrites
methods.description: Checks if a given accountId is permitted to write to channel cfg.

methods.name: authorizeConfigWrite
methods.description: Determines if account write permissions are allowed based on config.

methods.name: adaptScopedAccountAccessor
methods.description: Binds an accessor function to handle scoped account configs with correct context.

methods.name: createScopedAccountConfigAccessors
methods.description: Creates accessors for allowFrom and defaultTo based on account resolution functions.

methods.name: createScopedChannelConfigBase
methods.description: Builds base functions for scoped channel configuration with CRUD operations.

methods.name: createScopedChannelConfigAdapter
methods.description: Combines CRUD operations and allowFrom/defaultTo accessors into an adapter.

methods.name: createScopedDmSecurityResolver
methods.description: Creates a resolver for DM (direct message) policies within a channel, based on account info.

methods.name: createTopLevelChannelConfigBase
methods.description: Builds top-level channel config with enable and delete semantics.

methods.name: createTopLevelChannelConfigAdapter
methods.description: Combines top-level CRUD with separate accessor resolution.

methods.name: createHybridChannelConfigAdapter
methods.description: Adapter for hybrid configuration combining CRUD and allowFrom/defaultTo.
